The IRGC says it shot down a U.S. MQ-9A Reaper unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) over the city of Khormoj, Bushehr Province, southern Iran.
Unconfirmed reports also indicate that two additional MQ-9 drones may have been downed, one over Tabriz and another over Isfahan.
According to locals, the IRGC has launched four ballistic missiles from Fars Province.

U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that it conducted a wave of airstrikes against 80 targets using precision-guided munitions and destroyed 60 IRGC Navy fast-attack boats in retaliation for Iranian attacks on the vessels M/T Al Rekayyat, M/T Wedyan, and M/T Cyprus Prosperity.
According to CENTCOM, U.S. forces targeted Iranian air defense systems, command-and-control networks, coastal radar sites, anti-ship missile capabilities, and more than 60 Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) small boats operating in and around the Strait. The strikes were aimed at degrading Iran’s ability to continue attacks against international commercial shipping along the vital trade corridor.
